rk_p1_d: Keep, set aside to delete, or favorite. Undo anytime.

sup_meta: Help and contact for the Rollkeep iPhone app.
sup_lede: Questions, problems, or ideas? Email {email}. We usually reply within a few days.
sup_q1: I deleted a photo by mistake. Can I get it back?
sup_a1: Yes. Rollkeep deletes through iOS, so deleted items go to the Photos app’s “Recently Deleted” album for 30 days. Open Photos › Albums › Recently Deleted and tap Recover.
sup_q2: Why does the app say “about” next to storage sizes?
sup_a2: On some iOS versions Rollkeep can’t read the exact file size, so it shows an estimate based on resolution and video length. On iOS 27 and later it shows the exact size when available.
sup_a3: Not unless you clearly choose to. Favorites that end up in the delete queue automatically are skipped, and Rollkeep asks before you queue a favorite yourself.
sup_q4: How do I change ad or tracking choices?
sup_a4: In Rollkeep, open Settings › Privacy & Ads. Tracking can also be changed in iOS Settings › Privacy & Security › Tracking. Features and the number of ads are the same either way.
sup_a5: One banner on the Today screen and one on the Months screen, sometimes a full-screen ad after you finish a month and tap Home (at most twice a day), and a rewarded ad only if you choose to watch one. Never on the screens where you view, sort, or delete photos, or in widgets.
sup_q6: Can I use Rollkeep with “Limited Access” to photos?
sup_a6: Yes. Rollkeep works with the photos you select, and you can change the selection in the app at any time. Full access works best for month-by-month cleanup.
